description: Header file defining symbol classes for a shader compiler, including symbols for variables, functions, structures, and interface blocks, with methods for symbol management and querying.

classes.name: TSymbol
classes.description: Base class for all symbols representing variables, functions, structures, and interface blocks in the shader compiler.

classes.name: TVariable
classes.description: Represents a variable symbol, including constants and user-defined variables.

classes.name: TStructure
classes.description: Represents a structure type symbol, including methods for creating sampler symbols.

classes.name: TInterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block symbol, including layout and binding information.

classes.name: TParameter
classes.description: Structure used for parsing user-defined function parameters, capable of creating variable symbols.

classes.name: TFunction
classes.description: Represents a function symbol, including methods for adding parameters, mangling names, and querying properties.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the symbol's name.

methods.name: getMangledName
methods.description: Returns the mangled name of the symbol.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if the symbol is a function.

methods.name: isVariable
methods.description: Checks if the symbol is a variable.

methods.name: isStruct
methods.description: Checks if the symbol is a struct.

methods.name: isInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Checks if the symbol is an interface block.

methods.name: uniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the symbol.

methods.name: symbolType
methods.description: Returns the type of the symbol.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Returns the extension associated with the symbol.

methods.name: createVariable
methods.description: Creates a variable symbol from a parameter.

methods.name: createSamplerSymbols
methods.description: Creates sampler symbols within a structure.

methods.name: setAtGlobalScope
methods.description: Sets whether the structure is at global scope.

methods.name: atGlobalScope
methods.description: Checks if the structure is at global scope.

methods.name: blockStorage
methods.description: Returns the storage layout of the interface block.

methods.name: blockBinding
methods.description: Returns the binding index of the interface block.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to a function.

methods.name: shareParameters
methods.description: Shares parameters from another function.

methods.name: getFunctionMangledName
methods.description: Returns the mangled name of the function.

methods.name: getReturnType
methods.description: Returns the return type of the function.

methods.name: getBuiltInOp
methods.description: Returns the built-in operator associated with the function.

methods.name: setDefined
methods.description: Marks the function as defined.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the function is defined.

methods.name: setHasPrototypeDeclaration
methods.description: Marks the function as having a prototype declaration.

methods.name: hasPrototypeDeclaration
methods.description: Checks if the function has a prototype declaration.

methods.name: getParamCount
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Returns a parameter at a specific index.

methods.name: isKnownToNotHaveSideEffects
methods.description: Checks if the function is known to have no side effects.

methods.name: isMain
methods.description: Checks if the function is the main function.

methods.name: isImageFunction
methods.description: Checks if the function is an image function.

methods.name: isAtomicCounterFunction
methods.description: Checks if the function is an atomic counter function.

methods.name: hasSamplerInStructOrArrayParams
methods.description: Checks if the function has sampler parameters in structs or arrays.

methods.name: hasSamplerInStructOrArrayOfArrayParams
methods.description: Checks if the function has sampler parameters in nested structs or arrays.
